hero.look: the narrator: oversized charcoal hoodie with a cyan bracket logo and drawstrings, cargo joggers, high-top sneakers, messy layered dark hair with a teal streak, headphones round the neck, a beat-up laptop; a floating rank tag reads #8,000,000,000

baker.look: round baker: white jacket with a checked apron, tall chef hat, warm brown skin, moustache

kids.look: two small kids (child body): school uniforms, backpacks, one with pigtails, one with a cap

pros.look: elite team of four: matching black-and-magenta jackets with team numbers, visor glasses, spiky and slick hair, laptops held like weapons

crowd.look: a dozen townsfolk in varied colourful clothes, each with a floating rank tag

locations.street: neon city street at night: tall towers with lit windows, holographic signs, wet road reflecting colour, a bakery and a school front, glyph rain in the sky
locations.plaza: the Vault plaza: a monolith tower under a hexagonal firewall dome, searchlights, a crowd behind barriers, a giant sky scoreboard
locations.terminal: the small public terminal at the foot of the Vault door, screen glowing

shots.narration: In this world, everybody plays CTF.
shots.action: crane down past the sky scoreboard into the busy neon street; people walk, rank tags floating over them
shots.camera: high crane down from the scoreboard to street level

shots.narration: Even the bakery hides a flag in its receipts.
shots.action: the baker hands over bread; a receipt hologram pops up with a glowing flag{...} line
shots.camera: medium on the baker at the shop counter, slight push-in

shots.narration: Kids learn SQL injection before multiplication.
shots.action: two kids outside the school cheer at a floating ' OR 1=1-- hologram; the school sign glitches
shots.camera: low angle on the kids, school sign above

shots.action: the hero alone on the pavement, the rank tag above them flickers to #8,000,000,000; slump
shots.camera: close on the hero, pull up to reveal the tag

shots.narration: Tonight is the World Final. One flag, locked inside the Vault.
shots.action: reveal the Vault tower under the hex firewall dome, searchlights sweeping, crowd behind barriers
shots.camera: wide low orbit around the dome

shots.action: the pro team steps forward in formation and raises their laptops
shots.camera: low hero shot of the team, slow push

shots.narration: Zero-days. Rainbow tables. An actual botnet.
shots.action: packet beams and a rainbow beam hit the dome, impacts ripple; a swarm of drones dives in; sparks
shots.camera: fast side tracking along the beams, camera shake

shots.action: dome flickers and holds; drones drop; the pros slump

shots.narration: So I tried the one thing nobody did.
shots.action: the hero walks through the crowd to the little terminal at the Vault door
the hero's hand on the keyboard (IK), the screen fills with HTML
shots.camera: over the shoulder onto the screen

shots.action: silent beat: the screen scrolls and one green comment line lights up: <!-- flag{it_was_in_the_source} -->

shots.narration: The flag was in a comment.
shots.action: the dome shatters into hexes, the Vault opens, glyph confetti bursts, the crowd's jaws drop
shots.camera: wide pull-back from the opening Vault

shots.action: the sky scoreboard flips; the hero's tag spins to #1; victory jump
shots.camera: low angle on the hero, scoreboard behind

shots.narration: And everybody in this world checks the source first.
shots.action: back on the street: everyone, the baker and kids included, types view-source; screens glow green
shots.camera: crane up from the street back to the scoreboard
